sources.full: The Game Master's Deck of Wild Magic and Mischief

deck.name: Wild Magic and Mischief

entries: Prepare to Wield Wild Magic!

The {@i Game Master's Deck of Wild Magic and Mischief} is a collection of 40 cards designed to transform your worlds and elevate your combat with chaotic, vibrant magic. It is an adrenaline shot of gleeful chaos to the heart of the 5e system. Too often, our fantasy worlds are mere backdrops—a mundane stage upon which the fantastical arts. This deck makes your world an active player in your story—a world where incredible, impossible power simmers beneath the fabric of reality. This power sings and spirals, bubbles and bursts, helps and hinders and exists in all things. It is what we call Wild Magic.

entries.name: Wild Magic Transforms Your World
entries: Each card in this deck represents a fount of Wild Magic—a magical phenomenon formed from the chaos of woven arcana. These are moments where the rigid rules of reality crack under the pressure of chaotic energy. At the start of a combat encounter, draw a card at random from the deck. Each card has a corresponding page in this booklet. The Fount of Wild Magic section atop each entry introduces unique conditions that transform a combat encounter, giving heroes and monsters alike incredible powers to wield and unpredictable dangers to survive.

Founts of Wild Magic are unstable—the universe never tolerates such unbridled chaos for more than a few minutes—and they rarely ravage an area larger than one mile wide. In game, a fount will last until the end of a combat encounter, at which time it collapses back into nothingness and the card that triggered it is shuffled back into the deck.

entries.name: Wild Magic Surges for Heroes
entries: In a breathless moment of heroism, a towering barbarian lets out a furious  scream as Wild Magic envelopes her. The chaos heeds her fury, and the earth terraforms in response. This is a Wild Magic Surge—those moments when heroes are imbued with the power of Wild Magic. Every card in the deck has two types of surge: a Surge of Power and a Surge of Hope. A hero can trigger a Surge of Power or a Surge of Hope once each per long rest. Every Wild Magic Surge has a duration included in its effect, and once triggered, it persists even if the current Fount of Wild Magic changes or combat ends.

{@i {@b Surge of Power.}} A hero can choose to trigger a Surge of Power when they roll a natural 20 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw in combat. When they do, the Wild Magic of the fount reverberates around their triumph, potentially shifting into something new. That player can choose to use the Surge of Power listed on the current card or draw a new one. If they do, the Wild Magic effects of the current card end, but any existing Surges of Hope, Power or Monstrous Adaptations gained from it still persist. The player then draws a new card from the deck at random, and its Fount of Wild Magic effects begin. The hero who triggered the transformation then gains the Surge of Power effect of the new card in play. The surges often grant offensive abilities and the power to capitalize on an advantage.

{@i {@b Surge of Hope.}} A hero can choose to trigger a Surge of Hope when they roll a natural 1 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw in combat, or after they are struck by a Critical Hit. When they do, their moment of desperation spirals into the Weave and the Surge of Hope effect noted on the card in play takes effect. These surges often grant defensive abilities to a hero, alongside powers to turn the tide of battle in their favor.

entries.name: Wild Magic Surges for Antagonists
entries: A tarrasque, caught in a whirlwind of Wild Magic, erupts into flame. its flesh hardens and cracks like volcanic rock and earth at its feet liquefies to molten sludge. The monstrous titan lets loose a terrible, earth-shaking roar that transforms int a sizzling gout of flame.

Every card in this deck includes a Monstrous Adaptation. These are special mechanics that are added to a creature's stat block, reflecting a mighty transformation brought about by a Surge of Wild Magic. When combat begins and you draw a card from the deck, you can choose to enhance one NPC in play with a Monstrous Adaptation. Alternatively, you can choose to give an NPC a Monstrous Adaptation when they roll a natural 20 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw.

Monstrous Adaptations unite a monster with the Wild Magic of its environments—such creatures are lethal while adapted to an ongoing fount. Luckily, heroes can transform the current fount through Surges of Power, stripping enemies of their home environment. Some Monstrous Adaptations may even become detrimental to a creature if the Font of Wild Magic shifts to an effect it is unsuited for.

entries.name: Boons of Wild Magic
entries: Wild Magic is fleeting, but it can take root in a creature it feels drawn to. At GM discretion, when a player gains a feat, they can instead bind themselves to the living magic of the world. A hero draws a card from the deck at random or you choose a card for them. That hero gains +1 to one Ability Score of their choice and can trigger the Surge of Hope or Surge of Power on their chosen card once per day.

entries.name: The Language of the Deck
entries: This deck is balanced to work with all tiers of play, although due to the fragility of very low-level heroes, its recommended the deck mpt be used until Level 3. To account for balance across the game, all effects refer to the PB (Proficiency Bonus) of teh creatures they affect. As such, they scale with player levels and challenge ratings.

For example, the Fount of Flame's Monstrous Adaptation gives a creature the ability to discharge a fiery breath weapon attack, dealing PBd12 damage in a 5 x PB-foot cone. If a tarrasque (+9 PB) gains this Monstrous Adaptation, its breath weapon will deal 9d12 fire damage in a 45-foot cone.

entries.name: Make It Your Own
entries: This deck is subject to your discretion and can be modified as you see fit. If you want more insight into how to make the most of these cards, feel free to watch a {@link video|https://youtu.be/uGbC_nH4TKI?si=zEL_JukMTrSybtqp}.

card.name: Fount of Absolute Chaos
entries: The weave shatters. Wild Magic is free, untamed and unbounded. On initiative count 20 each round, roll {@dice 1d4}. On a result of 3 or 4, draw a card from the deck: Its effect takes place for the duration of this fount. If a player rolls a Surge of Hope or Surge of Power while more than one fount is active, they gain the effects on the card that was most recently revealed.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Chaos Initiate}
Roll 1d6: You immediately cast one of the following spells without components depending on the number rolled:

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Chaos Adaptation}
The spiraling madness of Wild Magic sings in harmony with your own energies. You gain a bonus to your AC and Saving Throws equal to twice the number of cards revealed by this fount.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Wild Magic Overload}

A creature with this adaptation is literally bursting with Wild Magic. Each time a new card is revealed by this fount's effect, thus creature can choose to gain the Monstrous Adaptation associated with that card. These adaptations stack. Each time a creature gains an adaption beyond its first, it takes PBd12 damage of a  random damage type.

card.name: Fount of Absolute Null
entries: An impossible, suffocating force clenches like an invisible fist around all things. Spells of spell level PB-1 or higher cannot be cast. Ongoing magical effects from spells of spell level PB-1 or higher end, as do lingering effects created by other Wild Magic founts.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Obstinate Magic}
In you, Wild Magic makes a valiant stand against the nulling forces of this fount. Choose one creature within 120 feet of you (you can choose yourself). For the next minute:

items: That creature can cast spells unimpeded by the Fount of Absolute Null.
Every time that creature casts a spell, it is accompanied by a shower of sparks and rainbows.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Primal Rites}
The quashing antimagic of this fount dampens all but the most primal of kinetic power. For the next minute:

items: You resist all damage aside from nonmagical bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage.
Your skin, hair, pupils, and nails turn earthy gray.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Numb}

A creature with this adaptation has been stripped bare of all magical influence, even that which sparks and dances within all living things. Unfeeling, unrelenting and utterly unmagical, it gains the following features for the next minute:

items: It cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
It gains resistance to all damage.
It has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
It has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

card.name: Fount of Armageddon
entries: An insidious, coiling dread wrenches at the spirits of all living things on the battlefield. At the start of each creature's turn, they must succeed on a DC8 + PB Constitution saving throw or fail to 1 hit point.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Indomitable Spirit}
Be it Wild Magic or the force of your own will, you have never known such courage. For the next minute:

items: You can choose to fail Constitution saving throws.
While you have exactly 1 hit point, any attack roll you make that hits a creature is a critical hit.
You are immune to the frightened, paralyzed and stunned conditions.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Unbreakable Spirit}
At the end of all things, radiant hope is your salvation. For the next minute:

items: If a creature within 30 feet of you (including yourself) would fall to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, you can use a reaction to envelope that creature with Wild Magic. The damage is reduced to 0 and that creature instead gains PBd12 temporary hit points.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Armageddon's Chosen}
A creature with this adaptation walks as one with death and devastation. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: While it has exactly 1 or 0 hit points, the creature is immune to damage, except radiant damage and damage from critical hits.
If it has 0 hit points, it does not fall unconscious. It does not die as a result of failing Death saving throws.
At the end of its turn, if the creature has 0 hit points and has not dealt damage to a creature since the start of its last turn, it dies.

card.name: Fount of Blistering Frost
entries: Blistering ice and cruel winds savage the battlefield. Creatures of CR 1/8 or lower are flash-frozen, petrified until the Wild Magic of the fount passes. Creatures not immune to cold damage cannot regain hit points, cannot gain temporary hit points and have their movement speed reduced by 10 feet. Additionally, when a creature deals damage of a type that isn't psychic, it can change that damage type to cold damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Heart of Ice}
The icy death of cruel Wild Magic finds a home in your heart. For the next minute:

items: You are immune to cold damage.
Cold damage you deal ignores damage resistances and immunities.
The first time you make a damage roll on your turn, you can add PB8d8 cold damage to the result.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Heart of Flame}
A gem of obstinate Wild Magic burns within you. For the next minute:

items: You are immune to cold damage.
Your movement speed increases by 10 feet.
You gain PBd4 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Blizzardborne}
A creature with this adaptation becomes one with the chilling cold. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Immune to cold damage.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes cold damage, you can use your reaction to reduce its movement speed by 5 x PB feet until the end of its next turn. A creature whose movement speed is reduced to 0 by this effect must succeed on a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

card.name: Fount of Caustic Acid
entries: Hissing corrosive acid bubbles and rises from the earth at your feet. Plants wither, stones melt and everything and everything is bathed in a luminous green radiance. Creatures who touch the ground on their turn or start their turn touching it takes PBd4 acid damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Acid Weaponry}
Wild Magic burns through you and into your weapons. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can dip a weapon or Arcane Focus you carry into the acid on the ground. If you do, the next time you hit with that weapon or damage a creature with a spell, you deal an additional PBd8 acid damage.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Acid Armor}
Far from corrosive pain, the acid seeping through the earth invigorates you. For the next minute:

items: Each time you would take acid damage, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Caustic Frenzy}
A creature with this adaptation is driven to wild distraction by the pain of blistering caustic acid. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: If it took acid damage since the start of its last turn, the creature has advantage on attack rolls and Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws. It also scores a critical hit on an attack roll of 18-20.
Attack rolls made against it have advantage.

card.name: Fount of Creeping Necrosis
entries: A sneaking, wriggling force of rot and decay laps at the air across the battlefield. Whenever a non-undead creature makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, it rolls a {@dice 1d4} and subtracts the number rolled from their result.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Necrotic Force}
Death magic trickles through your body like a creeping ichor. For the next minute:

items: Your eyes, lips and nails shift in hue to a deep purple.

Whenever you deal damage to a creature that doesn't have all oh its hit points, that creature takes an additional PB x 2 necrotic damage and you gain temporary hit points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt by that attack.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Unbreakable Spirit}
At the end of all things, radiant hope is your salvation. For the next minute:

items: If a creature within 30 feet of you (including yourself) would fall to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, you can use a reaction to envelope that creature with Wild Magic. The damage is reduced to 0 and that creature instead gains PBd12 temporary hit points.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Armageddon's Chosen}
A creature with this adaptation walks as one with death and devastation. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: While it has exactly 1 or 0 hit points, the creature is immune to damage, except radiant damage and damage from critical hits.
If it has 0 hit points, it does not fall unconscious. It does not die as a result of failing Death saving throws.
At the end of its turn, if the creature has 0 hit points and has not dealt damage to a creature since the start of its last turn, it dies.

card.name: Fount of Crushing Weight
entries: Crippling gravity devastates the battlefield. Creatures cannot jump or fly, and at the end of each turn, creatures with a Strength score of 19 or lower fall prone.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Giant's Strength}
Wild magic revels in contrasts. While others are brought low by crushing gravity magic, in you it blooms large. For the next minute:

items: If your size is Medium or smaller, your size becomes Large if there is room.
Your strength score increases to 21.
Your reach increases by 5 feet.
Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 damage.Your eyes, lips and nails shift in hue to a deep purple.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Worm Tactics}
At the end of all things, radiant hope is your salvation. For the next minute:

items: While you are prone, you have a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Vicious Opportunist}
A creature with this adaptation walks as one with death and devastation. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Strength score increases to 20 if it's lower than 20.
When it makes an attack roll at advantage against a prone creature, it can reroll one of the dice once.
When it hits a prone creature with an attack roll, it can reroll one of the dice once.

card.name: Fount of Drowning Rain
entries: Icy, torrential rain cascades in endless sheets onto the battlefield. All creatures resist fire damage, nonmagical flames are extinguished and the ground becomes difficult terrain for any creature without a swim speed. In addition, attack rolls that deal lightning damage on a hit have advantage and creatures have disadvantage on saving throws to avoid lightning damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Storm Thrower}
Wild Magic has blessed this battlefield with water and blessed you with the power to make it electrifying. For the next minute:

items: Your weapon attacks deal an additional {@dice 1d6} lightning damage on a hit.
Whenever you cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, poison or thunder damage, you can change the damage type to lightning.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Waterborne}
Far from a threat, the endless water around you feels like home. For the next minute:

items: You have a swim speed equal to your walking speed.
You resist lightning and cold damage.
While it is raining, you can use your swim speed to move through the air. If the rain stops while you are airborne, you fall.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Stormborne}
A creature with this adaptation rumbles with the thunderous fury of drowning storms, gaining the following features for the next minute:

items: It gains a swim speed equal to its walking speed.
It is immune to cold and lightning damage.
Its attack rolls and spells deal an additional {@dice 1d6} lightning damage.
Once per turn, when it deals lightning damage to a creature, all other creatures within 10 feet of that creature take PB x 2 lightning damage.

card.name: Fount of Falling Goblins
entries: On initiative count 20, a horde of goblins spawn 200 feet above the battlefield, each creature below must succeed on a DC12 + PB Dexterity saving throw or take PBd4 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone as a falling goblin strikes them before splattering on the ground.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Goblin Hurler}
The rain of dying goblins is a gift of Wild Magic. Magically imbued wi strength, for the next minute:

items: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use one of your attacks to hurl a small object (such as a goblin corpse) toward a creature up to 60 feet away. That creature must succeed on a DC12 + PB Dexterity saving throw or take PBd10 bludgeoning damage and fall prone as the object strikes it.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Goblin Dodger}
Falling goblins are a hazard, but Wild Magic always delivers a solution. Imbued with unnatural agility, for the next minute:

items: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Your AC increases by 2 if you aren't wearing armor. If you are wearing armor, it increases by 1.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Blood Frenzy}
Well accustomed to death, a creature with this adaptation gains the following ability for the next minute:

items: If a creature within 30 feet of it died or fell to 0 hit points since the start of its previous turn, it has advantage on all attack rolls and its movements speed increases by PB x 5 feet.

card.name: Fount of Flame
entries: Magical fire spirals through the air, infusing every living being  with blistering, frenetic flame. All movement speeds increase by 20 feet, all damage rolls deal an additional PB fire damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Sparks}
Your every strike is accompanied by a burst of crimson light and charring sparks. For the next minute:

items: Once per turn, when you deal fire damage to a creature with an attack or spell, that creature must succeed on a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Fire Shield}
The living heat of Wild Magic coils around you in a bubbling shell for the next minute:

items: You gain 5 x PB temporary hit points. For as long as you these temporary hit points, you resist fire damage and are immune to cold damage.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Molten Surge}
With a soul ignited by magical fire, a creature with this adaptation gains the following trait and action for the next minute:

items: Immune to fire damage.

In place of one of your attacks, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can release a burst of flame from your mouth or body in a 5 x PB-foot cone. Creatures in that area must succeed on a DC12 + PB Dexterity saving throw, taking PBd12 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. (Recharge 6)

card.name: Fount of Fondue
entries: The fifth and most delicious primal element of the universe, cheese, erupts into existence. Cheese covers every plant, gloms onto every rock and makes the earth springy and pungent at your feet. As a bonus action, a creature can cobble a handful of cheese, gaining PBd4 temporary hit points as long as it doesn't have the poisonous condition. Each time a creature takes this bonus action after the first, it must succeed on a DC5 + PB Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for the next minute. The DC of this saving throw increases by 1 each time the creature gobbles cheese.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Crackers for Cheese}
Emboldened by Wild Magic or by the natural, healthy urge to gobble cheese by the fistful, for the next minute:

items: You can take an additional bonus action on each turn if you use the first to gobble cheese.
You have advantage on Constitution saves to avoid or end the poisoned condition.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Fondue Summit}
Bolstered by the joy of a fully belly, for the next minute:

items: You have advantage on on Charisma (Persuasion and Performance) checks to interact with creatures. If both you and a creature have gobbled cheese in the last minute, you gain a +PB bonus to those checks.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Cheese Madness}
A creature with this adaptation has the dreaded Cheese Madness, gaining the following traits for the next minute:

items: Any temporary hit points it gains by gobbling cheese are tripled.
It has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to avoid the poisoned condition.

The creature finds it easier to form kinship with fellow cheese-lovers. At GM discretion, the creature is mre inclined to peaceful resolutions to disputes with creatures that have gobbled cheese in the last minute.

card.name: Fount of Force
entries: Wild Magic is power in its rawest form, and damage in its rawest form is force. All damage rolls  deal an additional PB force damage. The first time a creature is dealt force damage on a turn, it must succeed on a DC12 + PB saving throw or be pushed 10 feet directly away from the source of the damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b A Force One}
The Rapturous power of Wild Magic charges through you. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can cast {@i {@spell magic missile}} (1st level) without a spell slot or components.
Creatures immune to force damage instead take half damage from your spells and attacks that deal force damage.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b One With the Force}
The crackling Wild Magic of pure force sharpens your mind and heightens your awareness. For the next minute:

items: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Shimmering Shield}
A creature with this adaptation is hardened and inured to the harmful powers of Wild Magic. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Immune to force damage.
AC increases by 2 if it has dealt force damage to a creature since the start of its last turn.

card.name: Fount of Furry Fury
entries: Wild Magic ravages everything in the area with polymorphic energy. The course bark of trees shift into soft fur, grass and moss become fuzzy and every creature undergoes a bestial transformation, sprouting dense hair, razor teeth and raking claws.

All creatures are immune to bludgeoning, slashing and piercing damage from nonmagical, nonsilvered weapons. Unarmed strikes deal {@dice 1d8} magical slashing damage. If a creature's Strength modifier is lower than +4, it becomes +4.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b A Force One}
You become one with the Wild Magic of beasts. For the next minute:

items: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make a number of Unarmed Strikes equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you hit a creature with 3 or more Unarmed Strikes on your turn, you can make an additional Unarmed Strike as a bonus action.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Animal Instincts}
Your bestial transformation grants unexpected advantages. For the next minute:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception and Insight) checks.
Creatures cannot have advantage on attack rolls against you.
Once per turn, you can use 10 feet of movement to leap 10 x PB feet. This leap does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Bestial Rampage}
A creature with this adaptation surrenders itself fully to the beast within. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Its attack deal magical damage.
Its movement speed increases by 5xPB feet.
Opportunity attacks made against it have disadvantage.
It can make PB-1 Unarmed Strikes as a bonus action (minimum 1).

card.name: Fount of Ghastly Illusion
entries: Billowing, hallucinogenic tendrils of Wild Magic thicken the air with a poisonous odor that creates terrifying visions in the minds of those present. Creatures who are poisoned also have the Frightened condition, as hallucinatory terrors surround it. In addition, they take PBd10 poison damage at the start of their turn.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Terrifier}
Wild Magic of terror snakes through your body. For the next minute:

items: Once per turn, when you damage a creature, you can force that target to make a DC12 + PB Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature is frightened of you for the next minute, even if immune to the frightened condition. A creature can repeat its saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on success.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Toxin Purge}
Wild Magic drives all toxins from your body. For the next minute:

items: You are immune to the poisoned condition and poison damage.
You are immune to the frightened condition.
As an action, you can place your hand on one willing, allied creature to end the poisoned or frightened condition afflicting them.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Ghastly Radiance}
Poisonous fumes seep from this creature. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: You are immune to the poisoned condition and poison damage.
Advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.

Once per turn, when it hits a creature with an attack roll, that target must succeed on a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

card.name: Fount of Giants
entries: An eruption of Wild Magic infuses every creature with the fortitude and size of a giant. If there is room, creatures grow to Huge in size, their reach increases by 10 feet, they have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws and their Strength-based weapon attacks deal an additional {@dice 1d4} damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Fire Giant's Fury}
The fury of the fire giants lend strength to your transformation. For the next minute:

items: Once per turn, when you damage a creature, you can choose to deal an additional PBd8 fire damage to that target.
You resist fire damage
Creatures grappled by you take {@dice 1d10} fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Ice Giant's Resilience}
Wild Magic drives all toxins from your body. For the next minute:
In you, the mighty resilience of the ice giants find a home. For the next minute:

items: You resist cold and fire damage.
Your AC increases by PB as chilling vortex of ice and snow spirals around you.
If a creature within 15 feet of you targets you with a melee weapon attack, that creature cannot move until the start of iys next turn as the icy vortex surrounding you briefly freezes it in place.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Stone Giant's Fortification}
A creature with this adaptation is fortified with the iron will and skin of Stone Giants. It gains the following traits for the next minute:

items: Its size increases to maximum size for the space, up to Gargantuan.
Its weapon attacks deal an additional {@dice 1d4} damage.
It resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
As a reaction when hit by an attack, it can gain PB bonus to its AC until the end of the turn as its skin hardens to stone.

card.name: Fount of Gibbering Demons
entries: Wild Magic conjures terrible demons from beyond the veil of the material realm. On initiative count 20 each round, PB-1 {@b {@creature quasit|xmm|quasits}} spawn in a random location within the fount, all within an initiative order of 10. On their turn, they attack the nearest creature indiscriminately but will not attack each other.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Demon Command}
The same magic that brought demons to this realm grants you the authority to command them. For the next minute:

items: Your teeth grow to fangs, your eyes turn purple and your nails elongate into raking claws. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 slashing damage.

As a bonus action, you can designate one creature you can see within 120 feet of you as a target. All fiends of CR 1 or below within that range must use their next turn to move as close to the target as possible and attack it.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Demon Ally}
Wild Magic drives all toxins from your body. For the next minute:
The latent power of the abyss spirals around you, granting a fragment of the fortitude of demons. For the next minute:

items: Fiends of CR 1 or below have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
For as long as a fiend is within 120 feet of you, you share that creature's damage resistances and immunities.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Demon's Rampage}
Driven to frenzied bloodlust by demonic energy, a creature with this adaptation gains the following traits for the next minute:

items: After it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it van use its reaction to move up to its movement speed and make a single melee weapon attack.

Each time it reduces it reduces a fiend to 0 hit points, it gains +1 to all attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws until it finishes a short or long rest. It can gain this benefit a number of times equal to its PB.

card.name: Fount of Good Naps
entries: A whispering breeze; heady heat; and delicate, twinkling notes of music float across the battlefield. The area is bathed in dim light, illuminated by pinprick stars in the heavens. All creatures enter into a magical slumber and fall prone.

Creatures remain unconscious even if they take damage. Creatures magically wake at the start of their turn and remain conscious until the end of that turn. When a creature's turn ends, it once again collapses into slumber.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Juiced}
Wild Magic electrifies your entire being, countering the hypnotic sleepiness of this fount. For the next minute:

items: As long as you have 1 hit point, you are immune to the unconscious condition.
Your speed increases by 10 feet.
Your AC increases by 1.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Comatose}
In deep slumber, you are inured to harm. For the next minute:

items: While unconscious, you resist all damage.
While you are unconscious, you have advantage on all saving throws except Dexterity saving throws.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Sleepwalker}
A creature with this adaptation is almost as dangerous asleep as it is awake, guided by reactive instinct and fever dreams. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: It resist all damage while unconscious.
Once per turn, when it takes damage while unconscious, it makes a single melee weapon attack at disadvantage against a random creature within range, lashing out in its slumber.
As a reaction, when it takes damage while unconscious, it casts a random spell that it knows (if any), making a single melee weapon attack at disadvantage against a random creature within range.

card.name: Fount of Hot Potato
entries: Wild Magic spirals from one creature to the next. At the start of the turn of the creature acting first in the initiative order, that creature rolls {@dice 2d12}. If any of the dice rolled are a 1, they explode in a burst of flame and the creature takes fire damage equal to the total result of all the dice rolled. On any other result, they choose a creature within 120 feet who has not yet rolled to avoid exploding—that creature rolls at the start of their turn, repeating this process. For every creature that rolls beyond the first, that creature rolls an additional {@dice d12}. When a creature's dice explode, or all creatures have rolled to avoid exploding, this fount ends. Draw a new fount from the deck and apply its effects.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Potato King}
The Wild Magic of luck is with you. For the next minute:

items: When you or an allied creature within 30 feet of you rolls to avoid the effects of this fount, you can use your reaction to reroll any d12. You must use the result of the new roll.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Explosion Insurance}
Wild Magic fortifies you against the worst. For the next minute:

items: You gain resistance to fire damage.
You and everything you are wearing become damp to the touch.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Hot Potato Overlord}
A creature with this adaptation crackles and sparks with the force of a living storm. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Resistance to fire damage.

When the creature rolls to avoid exploding, it can choose PB creatures it can see to also roll the same amount of d12s. If any of the results on any of the dice rolled are a 1, all creatures that rolled take fire damage equal to the result of this creature's roll, as everyone bursts into flames.

card.name: Fount of Howling Wind
entries: A riotous hurricane batters the battlefield. The GM rolls 1d4 to determine the direction of the wind: 1. North, 2. East, 3. South, 4. West. On initiative count 20, all creatures must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 x PB feet in the direction the wind blows. Airborne creatures make this saving throw at disadvantage. If a creature is pushed into another creature or object, both take PBd4 bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Wind Rider}
Bless with the Wild Magic of the wind, you are fleet-footed and joyous in the midst of a hurricane. For the next minute:

items: You have a fly speed equal to your walking speed.
Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
You automatically succeed on saving throws to avoid being moved against your will by wind.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Anchoring Roots}
Just as Wild Magic can conjure obstacles, it can conjure shields. Roots burst from the earth and fortify you against the gale and incoming attacks. For the next minute:

items: You cannot be moved or knocked prone against your will.
You gain tremorsense out to 30 feet.
Attack rolls against you cannot be made with advantage.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Wind Avatar}
A creature with this adaptation is one with the cruel chaos of the howling wind. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: It automatically succeeds on saving throws to avoid being moved against its will by the wind.
It has a fly speed equal to walking speed.
While it is airborne, the creature has advantage on attack rolls against non-airborne creatures.
It can use its reaction to make a single melee weapon attack against any creature that leaves its reach, even if the creature leaves unwillingly.

card.name: Fount of Kineticism
entries: Invigorating kinetic magic ricochets across the battlefield. The stones at your feet quiver with excitement, flowers and trees flail without aid from the wind and the air dances and shimmers with electrifying Wild Magic.
All creatures' movement speeds increase by 20 feet. If a creature moves 50 feet or more on its turn, all subsequent attack rolls it makes on that turn have +PB to hit.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Kinetic Critical}
Exhilarated by blistering kinetic magic, your strikes are imbued with devastating force and speed. For the next minute:

items: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a creature before hitting it with an attack roll, the attack scores critical on a d20 roll of 18-20.
When you score a critical hit, you can use a reaction to take the Disengage or Dodge Action.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Kinetic Blur}
The sizzling well of Wild Magic inside you causes your whole body to vibrate and shimmer wildly, making your movements hard to track. For the next minute:

items: You gain +PB to your AC.
Your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Kinetic Thief}
A creature with this adaptation steals the energy of creatures around it. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: As a bonus action, you take the Dash action. When you do, creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, their movement speed falls to 0 and cannot be increased until the end of their next turn. For each creature that failed the save, you gain +1 to your AC until the start of your next turn. (Recharge 6)

card.name: Fount of Lightning
entries: Chaotic, writhing lightning crackles across the battlefield. On initiative count 20 each turn, each creature must succeed on a DC12 + PB Dexterity saving throw or take PBd4 lightning damage. Creatures made of metal, or wearing armor made of metal, make this save at disadvantage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Lightning Warrior}
You are one with the roaring tempest, and lightning fuels your power. For the next minute:

items: You gain resistance to lightning damage.
You can choose to fail Dexterity saving throws to avoid lightning damage.
You become charged when you take lightning damage. Once charged, the next damage roll you make deals an additional PBd12 lightning damage, and the charge ends.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Lightning Spirit}
Your soul is linked to the primal force of lightning. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You vanish and appear in a blinding bolt of lightning. When you use this feature, creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a DC12 + PB Dexterity saving throw or take PBd4 lightning damage.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Howling Tempest}
A creature with this adaptation crackles and sparks with the force of a living storm. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Resistance to lightning damage.

As an action, you emit a shattering, primal howl. Creatures within 60 feet of you make a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes PBd6 thunder damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn. If a creature fails this save by 5 or more, it is also stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage. (Recharge 6)

card.name: Fount of Living Magic
entries: All magic is alive, but here it's livelier (and deadlier) than usual. The first time a creature casts a leveled spell on each turn, that spell is treated as if it were cast using a spell slot 2 levels higher than the one expanded. Additionally, if a creature takes the Attack action, it can use a bonus action on that turn to cast one of the following cantrips: minor illusion, poison spray, ray of frost, spare the dying. If a cantrip cast using this requires a saving throw, the DC is 12 + PB.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Living Magic}
A living spell forms, playfully dancing around you and enhancing your lethality in battle. For the next minute:

items: The first time you hit a creature with a weapon attack each turn, you deal an additional PBd4 damage of a type you choose from among cold, fire or lightning.
Your spell save DC increases by 1.
You have a +1 to spell attack rolls.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Magical Guardian}
A living spell blossoms into life, warding you against incoming harm. For the next minute:

items: You resist damage from spells.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells.
You can cast the shield spell without a spell slot or components.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Magical Maelstrom}
A creature with this adaptation is infused with booming magical energy. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Two PB - 1 level spell slots, each of which can be expended to cast any spell from the Wizard spell list of that level or below. If the spell cast forces a saving throw, the DC save is 12 + PB. If the spell requires an attack roll, it is 14 + PB to hit.
After it takes damage from a spell, it gains temporary hit points equal to the level of the spell that damaged it.

card.name: Fount of Machines
entries: Mechanical, clockworkWild Magic and churns through the battlefield, terraforming all in its path. All creatures' flesh hardens to metal, and their internal organs transform into infinitely complex, whirring machinery. All creatures become constructs and resist bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Overclock}
Blessed with a new, mechanical form, you can tinker with your reserves to unlock new power. For the next minute:

items: Your movement increases by 10 feet.

You can take an additional action on your turn. If you do, at the end of that turn you must succeed on a DC 12 + PB Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Metalmorph}
Your steel body offers added protection. For the next minute:
As a reaction, when you take damage, you can emit a pulse of electrostatic energy. Choose one of the following effects

items: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +PB bonus to your AC and saving throws.
Other constructs within 10 feet of you take 3 x PB lightning damage.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Killing Machine}
A creature with this adaptation has become a frenzied mechanical monstrosity. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Immune to psychic damage.
Vulnerable to lightning damage.

At the start of its turn, it can choose to take two actions that turn. If it does, both of those actions must be the Attack action, and its movement speed falls to 0 until the end of its next turn. It cannot use this ability if its movement speed is 0.

card.name: Fount of Nature's Spite
entries: Grasping, thorny vines burst from the earth. The ground is consumed by 10-foot spiky plants that form a dense, hazardous jungle. The area they cover is difficult terrain, and creatures that move through it take PB-1 damage for every 5 feet they move.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Shredding Vines}
The Wild Magic of this fount grants you the ability to make use of its deadly garden. For the next minute:

items: When you use the Attack action or cast a spell on your turn, you can cast thorn whip as a bonus action that turn. You choose your spellcasting modifier or +7 when you cast thorn whip this way, whichever is higher.
When you hit a creature with a melee spell attack roll, you can move that creature PB x 5 feet directly toward or away from you.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Rising Winds}
In the clutches of grasping, earthen Wild Magic, you find a magical blessing that allows you to rise above danger. For the next minute:

items: You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. If you already have a fly speed, it increases by 30 feet.
You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws while airborne.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Earthen Warrior}
A creature with this adaptation is a warrior blessed with the elemental gifts of the earth. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: It has a 30-foot burrow speed but cannot end its turn below ground.
It can burrow through unworked earth an stone. While burrowing in this way, it doesn't disturb the material it moves through.
Once per turn, when it hits a creature with an attack roll, that creature is pushed PB x 5 feet directly away from it.

card.name: Fount of Obstinate Law
entries: The cold, iron magic of absolute law hammers down on all creatures across the battlefield. Lawful-aligned creatures can forgo a d20 for attack rolls and saving throws to get an 11 on the die instead. Additionally, when they damage a creature, they can forgo rolling for damage to instead get a result on an damage dice equals to half the dice's maximum roll. For example, a d8 would deal 4 damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Chaos Rebellion}
You are the antidote to inflexible magic-chaotic revelry incarnate. For the next minute:

items: Your alignment changes to chaotic.
You cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls.
When you roll to attack, you can treat natural 1s as a critical hit.
When you score a critical hit, you and the target of your attack are each teleported to a random, unoccupied space PB x 5 feet away.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Authority's Guidance}
The firm magic of hard law offers you guidance in your every action. For the next minute:

items: Your alignment changes to lawful.
You gain +PB to your d20 tests.
You gain +PB to your AC.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Even Retribution}
A creature with this adaptation is both empowered and bound by the unflinching rule of law. For the next minute, it gains the following trait:

items: Its alignment changes to lawful.
Any critical hit against it becomes a normal hit.
When it takes the Attack action on its turn, it can make another number of attacks equal to the number of creatures that dealt damage to it since the end of its last turn (minimum of 1).
It gains a bonus to its attack rolls equal to the number of creatures that dealt to it since the end of its last turn.

card.name: Fount of Ooze
entries: Ooze coats everything sticky, viscous slime, making the ground difficult terrain for all creatures except oozes. Whenever a non-ooze creature dies, the slime absorbs the corpse, transforming it into a gray ooze. When this fount ends, transformed corpses return to normal.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Conductive Ooze}
Wild Magic enables you to turn the dangers of the ooze to your advantage. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can cast the cantrip shocking grasp using Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for your spellcasting ability (choose when you get this surge).
You can target creatures within 30 feet of you with melee spell attacks as if they are within 5 feet, if touching the same source of ooze.
When you target a creature with a melee spell attack that deals lightning damage, you can target additional creatures equal to your PB-1 if you and your targets are touching the same source of ooze.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Amorphous}
This fount changes your physiology. For the next minute:

items: You, along with your equipment, can move through spaces 1 inch wide without squeezing.
You cannot be grappled.
You resist acid and poison damage.
You ignore difficult terrain caused by oozes.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Gelatinous}
A creature with this adaptation merges with a gelatinous ooze, gaining the following traits for the next minute:

items: It ignores difficult terrain created by oozes.
It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
If a creature touches or is touched by the ooze, it takes PBd4 acid damage.
It has advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that would alter its form.

card.name: Fount of Radiance
entries: Wild Magic infused with the divine warmth of a higher plane blesses this fount and all creatures within it bonded by fellowship. Bright sunlight illuminates the entire battlefield, dispelling any area of darkness created by a spell of 8th level or below. Creatures bathed in this light gain a +2 bonus to their AC and +PB to all ability checks and saving throws as long as they can see an allied creature within 30 feet of them.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Blessing of the Higher Plane}
The define might of the heavens flows through you like a gentle sigh of wind. For the next minute:

items: You have a 10-foot fly speed.
Whenever you make an attack roll or a saving throw, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to your result.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Command of the Higher Plane}
The law of divine magic is absolute, and its power surges through you. For the next minute:

items: You radiate dim golden light in a 10-foot radius.
You can cast command as a bonus action. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability modifier (choose when you activate this surge).

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Luminous Soul}
A creature with this adaptation blazes with the radiance of a distant plane of light. For the next minute, it gains the following features:

items: Resistance to necrotic damage.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits with an attack roll, you retaliate with a searing bolt of radiant energy. That creature must succeed on a DC12 + PB Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage and be blinded until the end of its next turn.

card.name: Fount of Rapturous Evil
entries: Evil is one of the destructive and addictive forms magic can take. Despite its cruelty, Wild Magic in this form often shares power with those it deems worthy. Evil-aligned creatures have advantage on saving throws and the first time each turn an evil-aligned creature deals damage to a creature, that creature takes an additional PB necrotic damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Evil's Bane}
At the heart of all evil lies a kernel of fear. For the next minute:

items: You can frighten evil-aligned creatures, even if they are immune to the frightened condition.
When you deal damage to an evil-aligned creature, you deal an extra PB radiant damage.

The first time each turn you deal radiant damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC12 + PB Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Light in the Darkness}
Magic of hope and life engulfs you, providing shelter against cruelty and hate. For the next minute:

items: If you are not good-aligned, you can choose to become good-aligned.
If you are good-aligned, you have advantage on saving throws.
If you are good-aligned, you are immune to necrotic damage and the frightened condition.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Harbinger of Hate}
A creature with this adaptation is transformed under the gleeful, ambitious Wild Magic of evil, gaining the following traits for the next minute:

items: Its alignment changed to evil.
Once per turn, if it deals necrotic damage to a creature, it gains Heroic Inspiration if it doesn't already have it.

card.name: Fount of Scheming Devils
entries: This fount has drawn the attention of a cabal of archdevils, who materialize as intangible specters to observe, influence and gamble on the outcome of the battle. At the start of a creature's turn, it can implore a devil for a magical boon by making a DC 12 + PB Charisma (Persuasion) check. Om a success, the creature can add 2d6 to the first damage roll or saving throw it makes before the start of their turn. If a creature does not make use of this boon in the alloted time, it takes PBd10 fire damage. Once a creature receives this boon, it cannot do so again until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Devilish Favor}
You have earned the favor of the devil who has gambled a great deal of souls betting on your success (and is more than willing to cheat to help you win). For the next minute:

items: You have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
At the end of your turn, one creature you can see within 60 feet takes PBd6 fire damage.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Fair Play}
A bubble of Wild Magic rises within you, furious at the machinations of the devilish interference. For the next minute:

items: Fiends, and creatures who have received a boon from a fiend, have disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have advantage on saving throws to resist or avoid their spells and attacks.
You resist fire damage.
You cannot entreat a boon from a fiend.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Archdevil's Chosen}
A creature with this adaptation is transformed under the gleeful, ambitious Wild Magic of evil, gaining the following traits for the next minute:

items: It can add 1d6 the first attack roll, damage roll and saving throw it makes each turn.
It resists fire damage.
It has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion and Intimidation) checks to interact with devils.

card.name: Fount of Shadow
entries: Magical shadows cloak the battlefield, drowning all nonmagical sources of light and plunging everything into darkness. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Eyes of Night}
Wild Magic grants you the power to fight while under the blanket of total darkness. For the next minute:

items: You can see in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a range of 120 feet.
You have a +PB bonus to damage rolls when damaging a creature that can't see you.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Earthen Ally}
Against the oppressive darkness, an ally comes to your aid: Wild Magic channeled through the earth at your feet. For the next minute:

items: You have tremorsense out to 30 feet.

When a blinded creature makes an attack roll against a creature within 30 feet of you, you ca use your reaction to change the target of that attack to another creature within 5 feet of the target, subtly shifting the earth st their feet to alter the trajectory of their strike.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Shadow Hunter}
A creature with this adaptation is perfectly crafted by Wild Magic of darkness to hunt and slay under its protection for the next minute:

items: It has blindsight out to 60 feet.
When it makes an attack roll against a blinded creature, it scores a critical hit on a result of 18, 19 or 20 on the d20.
It can use a bonus action to teleport up to 60 feet and then immediately take the Hide action. It can use this trait PB times per long rest.
It has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws while not in dim light or darkness.

card.name: Fount of Shining Light
entries: Bright light illuminates the battlefield and runs through all things upon it. All creatures shed bright light in a 10-foot radius, have disadvantage on Stealth checks and gain no benefit from being invisible. The light of this fount overrides any darkness, magical or otherwise.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Light Warrior}
You are guided by the light within and can channel that power into others. For the next minute:

items: You cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls or saving throws.

Once per turn, when you damage a creature with an attack or spell, you can force it to make a DC 12 + PB Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is subjected to the effects of the faerie fire spell. It can repeat its save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Light Medic}
The Wild Magic of this fount lets you weave pure light into healing magic. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can place a hand on a willing creature and restore PBd4 hit points to that creature. If you restore a creature to full hp with this effect, you gain a point of Heroic Inspiration.
Any creature you heal with a spell, item or trait gains PB x 3 temporary hit points.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Searing Radiance}
A creature with this adaptation is a glorious beacon of searing light. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Its body glows painfully bright. Creatures that start their turns within 10 feet of it take PBd4 radiant damage and are blinded.
It automatically fails any Stealth checks.
It resists necrotic and radiant damage.

card.name: Fount of Singing Stones
entries: Every rock, pebble and stone in the area springs to life and launches into one highly choreographed musical number after another. All creatures in the area are deafened, and the area is difficult terrain for creatures without proficiency in Performance (who are able to weave and dance in time with thr animated stones). Constructs must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of their turns or be forced to use their action and movement to dance until the start of their next turn.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Stone's Order}
The compulsive Wild Magic of this fount grants you a measure of control over the singing stones. For the next minute:

items: You can cast animate objects without a spell slot or components. When you cast it in this way, the maximum number of objects you can animate is equal to your PB, and they must be Tiny. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting modifier for this spell.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Lost in the Crowd}
You find harmony with the musical, animated stones as Wild Magic guides you along with their movements. For the next minute:

items: You have three-quarter cover.
You ignore difficult terrain created by the stones.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Inspiration}
A creature with this adaptation is enraptured with the music and dance magic of this fount. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Its speed increases by 10 feet.
It gains proficiency in Performance.
It has advantage on Performance checks and Dexterity saving throws.
At the start of its turn, it gains a point of Heroic Inspiration if it doesn't have one.

card.name: Fount of Sizzling Thought
entries: Perhaps the greatest magic is the magic of thought. Thought Wild Magic pulses across the battlefield - an invisible, infinitely adaptable force of creativity and consciousness runs giddy and dizzying through the minds of all creatures. Creatures with an Intelligence score of 18 or lower are poisoned, overcome by the reeling pace of their increasingly addled minds.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Mind Into Matter}
You can channel the potent thought magic of the fount to create forms from your mind. For the next minute:

items: If your Intelligence is lower than 19, it becomes 19.
You know the spells mirror image and major image and can cast them as a bonus action without a spell slot or components. The save DC for these spells is 8 + Intelligence Modifier + PB.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Steady Mind}
In a swirling vortex of magic thought, you find a place of calm within your mind to weather the storm. For the next minute:

items: You are immune to the poisoning effect of this fount.
You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws and on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Wild Thoughts}
A creature with this adaptation has a mind electrified with chaos as well as opportunity. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Intelligence score becomes 19 if it is less than 19.
It learns two spells from the wizard spell list of spell level PB or lower (at GM discretion) and can cast those spells once each without a spell slot or components.
It can concentrate on two spells as once.

card.name: Fount of Teleportation
entries: Unstable conjuration magic ricochets from person to person. All creatures can use a bonus action to teleport up to PB x 5 feet to an unoccupied space they can see within range.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Compulsory Teleport}
Your teleportation magic is so potent that you can force it upon other creatures. For the next minute:

items: You shimmer and flicker, even when standing still.
As a bonus action, you can teleport one creature within 5 feet of you PB x 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see (including in the air).

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Dimensional Gifts}
In the act of teleporting, you can pass across dimensions. With Wild Magic guiding you, you can capture a small fragment of dimensional energy. For the next minute:

items: Whenever you teleport, choose one of the following boons as you reappear:
You immediately take the Dodge action.
You immediately make one weapon attack.
You regain 1d6 x PB hit points.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Flash Warrior}
A creature with this adaptation is a whirlwind of unwieldy conjuration magic. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: When it takes the Attack action, it can teleport up to PB x 5 feet immediately before making each attack roll.
It has a cumulative +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for each time it has teleported that turn.
Once per turn, when it casts a spell, target(s) of that spell must succeed on a DC12 + PB Charisma saving throw or be teleported PB x 5 feet to an unoccupied space it can see (including in the air).

card.name: Fount of The Fey
entries: Unstable conjuration magic ricochets from person to person. All creatures can use a bonus action to teleport up to PB x 5 feet to an unoccupied space they can see within range.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Fey Guile}
The shrewd cunning of fey magic invigorates you. For the next minute:

items: You can add your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma modifier to your attack rolls and ability checks (choose when you activate this surge).

Once per turn, after you damage a creature with an attack or spell, you can force the target to make a DC12 + PB Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, that creature is charmed for one minute or until it takes damage. A charmed creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Tiny Tactician}
Your small size provides powerful advantages. For the next minute:

items: You have a +PB bonus to your AC.
You can take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Hide action as a bonus action.
When hit by a weapon attack, you can choose to have that attack push you up to 30 feet in a direction you choose. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Unyielding Colossus}
A creature with this adaptation ignores the magic of this fount and gains the following traits:

items: Its size cannot be reduced.
It has advantage on melee attack rolls against smaller creatures than it.
When it deals damage to a creature tht is two or more sizes smaller than it with a weapon attack, that creature falls prone.

card.name: Fount of The Gambler
entries: Wild Magic promises power to those daring enough to take it. Whenever a creature makes an attack rolls, it can choose to roll at disadvantage (if not already at disadvantage). If it hits, it can choose one of the following boons:

items: its attack deals an additional 2 x PB damage.
It gains 1d6 x PB temporary hit points.
It uses its reaction to move up to 5 x PB feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Cheater}
You are blessed by mischievous magic for the next minute:

items: Once per turn, if you choose to roll at disadvantage, you can choose to invoke this surge before rolling the dice and take the higher result rather than the lower.
When a creature makes an attack roll against you at advantage, you can use your reaction to force that creature to take the lower of the two dice a sa result rather than the higher.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Gambling Insurance}
Wild Magic wards you from harm should things not go your way when you gamble. For the next minute:

items: If you miss an attack roll made at disadvantage, you gain + PB bonus to your next attack roll that isn't made at disadvantage.
If a creature hits you with an attack roll made at disadvantage, you can use use your reaction to interfere with its boon. You, rather than it, choose the effect it gains from the fount.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Fortune Favored}
This adaptation blesses a creature with supernatural good fortune. For the next minute, the following applies:

items: When it makes an attack roll at disadvantage, it gains a +PB bonus to hit.
When it hits a creature with an attack roll made at disadvantage, it can choose two boons from this fount rather than only one.

card.name: Fount of The Living Dead
entries: Necrosis ravages the area, conjuring skeletal corpses that litter the battlefield. All living creatures become undead, resist necrotic and poison damage and cannot regain hit points until the fount ends.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Death Caller}
Your mighty soul can call the dead to action. For the next minute:

items: As a bonus action, you can cause a number of corpses (skeletons) up to your PB to spring to unlife under your command. They follow any orders you give them (no action required) and they take their turn immediately after yours. You can only control a number of undead equal to your PB at any given time.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Warded}
You resist the evil, necrotic Wild Magic and return to normal. For the next minute:

items: You are immune to the effects of this fount.
Undead creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
Undead cannot willingly move within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Eternal Zombie}
A creature with this adaptation is infused with the ravenous, entropic powers of undeath - a decaying, eternal monstrosity. For the next minute, it gains the following traits:

items: Its Intelligence and Charisma scores fall to 7 if they are higher.
Once per turn, when it deals damage to an undead creature, it gains PB temporary hit points.
It has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.

If damage reduces it to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + half the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, it falls to 1 hit point.

card.name: Fount of The Rising Dragon
entries: Crackling Wild Magic heralds a force of unimaginable draconic power. On initiative count 20 each round, PB + 1 {@b kobolds} appear in random, unoccupied spaces. They chant in unison but take no actions. If eight or more kobolds are chanting at the start of initiative count 20, a chromatic dragon of CR PB + 10 or less appears and attacks all creatures on the battlefield indiscriminately.

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Kobold Killer}
A draconic threat spurs you to incredible action. For the next minute:

items: If you damage a kobold as part of your action, you can take an additional action that turn.
You have advantage on attack rolls made against kobolds.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Draconic Boon}
The chromatic lineage od dragons burns through your body. For the next minute:

items: You grow a pair of spectral, draconic wing. You have a fly speed equal to your walking speed.
At the start of your turn, choose one damage type from among acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Until the start of your next turn, you resist that damage type.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Kobold Control}
A creature with this adaptation draws strength from the fount and the waves of kobolds it spawns. For the next minute:

items: While there are 2 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to ability checks.
While there are 4 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to attack checks.
While there are 6 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to saving throws.
While there are 8 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it is immune to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison damage, and it has a +PB bonus to AC.

card.name: Fount of The Ultimate
entries: The sizzling Wild Magic of opportunity elevates our heroes. When you draw this card, each player character chooses Surge of Hope or Surge of Power. The GM then shuffles this card back into the deck and draws a new card. The new fount effect takes place, with each hero gaining the Surge of Hope or Surge of Power on that card (depending on their choice) and one enemy gaining its Monstrous Adaptation.

If this card was drawn by its own effect, the Wild Magic skyrockets into the air, bursting and crackling in a cacophonous display of light and smoke. Remove this card from the deck and all players gain the following feat:

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Feat}
In a moment of spectacular fortuity, a fragment of Wild Magic has made home within your soul.

items: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Once per long rest, when you fail a d20 test, you can treat the result on the d20 as a natural 1.
Once per long rest, when you succeed a d20 test, you can treat the result on the d20 as a natural 20.

Once in a campaign, at GM discretion, when you trigger a Surge of Hope or Surge of Power, you can forgo that boon to instead gain the benefit of the Monstrous Adaptation of that fount for the next minute.

card.name: Fount of Transformation
entries: Transmutational magic rips through every creature within this fount. On initiative count 20 each round, each creature rolls 1d6 and gains the relevant boon listed on the table, its body temporarily transforming to provide the benefit noted. This lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round, at which point all creatures re-roll.

rows: {@b Hummingbird.} Receive a fly speed equal to half your walking speed and you can hover
{@b Snail.} Gain half cover and your speed is halved
{@b Leopard.} Double your walking speed and gain a climb speed of 30 feet
{@b Hawk.} +2 bonus to ranged attack rolls
{@b Bear.} +2 bonus to Strength-based attack rolls
{@b Fox.} +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves; Spell Save DC increases by 1

entries.name: Surge of Power
entries: {@b Polymorphic}
Gain the power to transform. For the next minute:

items: You can cast polymorphic without a spell slot or components but must target yourself or an ally.

entries.name: Surge of Hope
entries: {@b Limited Control}
You gain a small measure of control over your transformation. For the next minute:

items: Instead of rolling on the table, choose two transformations. You gain the benefit of both.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation
entries: {@b Endless Enhancement}
This adaptation provides a creature with the following:

items: Any bonus a creature gained from this fount lasts until it finishes a short or long rest.
A bonus to Strength and Dexterity saving throws equal to the number of unique boons it has received.
